name: Cape of the Mountebank

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dimension Door
powers.text: Once per dawn, cast Dimension Door, vanishing in a puff of smoke.

summary: Once a day, cast Dimension Door in a puff of smoke.
text: This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast Dimension Door. This property of the cape can't be used again until the next dawn. When you disappear, you leave behind a cloud of smoke, and you appear in a similar cloud of smoke at your destination. The smoke lightly obscures the space you left and the space you appear in, and it dissipates at the end of your next turn.
